backlog.summary_en: CollabFlow trains a collaboration director while adding, modifying, and removing library skills in response to team execution outcomes. Revised textual strategies are bound to agents in later evolution steps, supporting a model-and-Harness coevolution classification. Its skill-edit analysis selects the steps with the largest gains while the director also changes, so the observed gains cannot be attributed to skill edits alone.
backlog.summary_zh: CollabFlow 一边训练协作规划器，一边依据团队执行结果增删改技能库，并将修订后的文本策略绑定到后续轮次的 Agent。两条更新链使其符合模型与外部 Harness 共演化。技能编辑分析聚焦于增益最大的步骤，且规划器同步训练，因此不能据此把收益单独归因于技能修改。
backlog.title: CollabFlow: Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Collaboration

backlog.short_title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents
backlog.summary_en: This study turns expert diagnoses of verification failures into versioned procedural guidance, skills, and tool interfaces, and evaluates how these resources affect coding-agent verification. It supports a Harness-specific evaluation classification. The resources are expert maintained and the controlled effect intervals span zero; the study does not establish autonomous Harness evolution, a general benefit, or transfer to an independently held-out task family.
backlog.summary_zh: 研究将专家对验证失败的诊断沉淀为版本化的程序指导、技能与工具接口，并比较这些资源对编码 Agent 验证行为的影响。可作为 Harness 专项评测收录；资源由专家维护，受控对照的效应区间跨零，既不证明自主 Harness 演化，也未确认普遍收益或独立留出集迁移。
backlog.title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents

held_out.quote: tasks that a controller was never trained for

backlog.summary_en: InterEvolve revises staged reward programs, transition conditions, and constants using simulation feedback. These programs drive a frozen controller at inference, and selected programs with verifier records enter a skill library for later composition and adaptation. This supports Harness-component evolution. Freezing applies to the evolution phase, and physical demonstrations reuse simulation-evolved programs rather than establishing autonomous online evolution on a robot.
backlog.summary_zh: InterEvolve 根据仿真执行反馈修改分阶段奖励程序、转移条件和常数，用它们在推理时驱动冻结的控制器，并将选中的程序与验证记录保留在技能库中供后续任务组合和修改。它符合 Harness 组件演化；模型冻结限于演化阶段，实机展示沿用仿真中生成的程序，未证明物理环境中的在线自主演化。
backlog.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

backlog.summary_en: SkillScriptBench evaluates repairs to skill-package instructions and executable scripts, including feedback-guided revision, documentation–code consistency, and preservation of correct behavior. It is a Harness-specific evaluation. Its faults are constructed or injected, so local maintenance results do not establish long-term autonomous evolution across tasks or general downstream reliability.
backlog.summary_zh: SkillScriptBench 评测 Agent 对技能包说明和可执行脚本的修复，检查验证反馈下的修订、文档与代码一致性及原有正确行为的保留。它适合作为 Harness 专项评测。故障均为构造或注入，局部维护结果尚不能证明跨任务长期自主演化或下游系统的普遍可靠性。
backlog.title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown

backlog.summary_en: SkillForge trains the model while maintaining an external skill library. Execution rewards and failure trajectories guide child-skill generation. Trial skills become active after a usage threshold; fitness and usage govern stabilization and retirement, and later rollouts retrieve from the revised library. This supports a model-and-Harness coevolution classification. Shared task rewards do not isolate each skill’s causal contribution, and the teacher can introduce external knowledge.
backlog.summary_zh: SkillForge 同时训练模型并维护外部技能库。它根据执行回报和失败轨迹生成子技能；试用技能达到使用次数门槛后转为活跃状态，稳定与退休再按表现和使用次数管理，更新后的技能库用于后续检索。它符合模型与 Harness 共演化；共享任务回报并不能单独确认每个技能的因果贡献，且教师会带入外部知识。
backlog.title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles

backlog.summary_en: EvoQuantLab uses search traces and development-stage overfitting diagnostics to revise the protocol, terminal budgets, and constraints of subsequent quantitative research cycles without training model weights. Accepted child protocols retain their parent lineage and are loaded in the next cycle. The Harness evidence concerns this persistent research controller, not the generated financial factors; the cycle case study is a temporal audit rather than a causal comparison.
backlog.summary_zh: EvoQuantLab 在不训练模型权重的量化研究流程中，用开发阶段的搜索轨迹与过拟合诊断修订后续研究循环的协议、终端预算与约束，并将带父版本记录的子协议加载到下一轮。Harness 证据来自这层持久研究控制程序，内层生成的金融因子本身仍是任务产物；跨轮案例属于时间序列审计，不能单独归因为协议更新的因果收益。
backlog.title: EvoQuantLab: Training-Free Dual-Loop Evolution for Auditable Quantitative Research

backlog.short_title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
backlog.summary_en: Multimodal Filesystem Memory lets an agent create, revise, and disable textual or executable procedures using execution feedback, then reuse them in later lives and tasks. The Harness evidence concerns editable procedural skills; spatial notes and working-memory content remain a separate memory branch. These skill-reuse results do not establish a success-rate improvement across all tasks, nor do they show that every stored procedure is beneficial or that a larger skill library is always better.
backlog.summary_zh: Multimodal Filesystem Memory 允许 Agent 根据执行结果创建、修改和停用文本或可执行 procedure，并在后续生命与任务中复用。Harness 证据来自可修改的过程技能分支；位置笔记和工作记忆仍属于记忆内容。这些技能复用结果不代表所有任务成功率提高，也不意味着每个存储过程都有益或技能库越大越好。
backlog.title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents

backlog.summary_en: With the actor frozen, execution counterexamples revise reusable checkers; accepted verifier versions and repair records carry into later improvement rounds. Cross-task adaptation of the constructor is not evaluated.
backlog.summary_zh: 冻结执行模型，依据执行反例修订可重跑检查器，并将验收后的验证器版本与修复记录带入后续改进轮次。跨任务改进构造器的循环尚未评测。
backlog.title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents

backlog.short_title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
backlog.summary_en: The harness separates the original objective from mutable plans and execution records, with planner, worker, and reviewer roles; a setup agent revises reusable instructions from trial trajectories and tool feedback. It passes 83 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 instances (93.26%); these results concern the complete configuration, without isolating instruction evolution.
backlog.summary_zh: 该 Harness 将原始目标、可修改计划与执行记录分离，由 planner、worker、reviewer 协作；setup agent 根据试运行轨迹和工具反馈修订可复用指令。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上通过 89 个实例中的 83 个（93.26%）；结果针对完整配置，未隔离指令演化的单独贡献。
backlog.title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness

backlog.short_title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization
backlog.summary_en: Drawing on RL pass@k analysis, the study compares harnesses before and after optimization to distinguish more reliable elicitation from broader task coverage. In the evaluated settings, pass@1 advantages can reverse at larger attempt budgets; this is a focused diagnostic evaluation of harness optimization.
backlog.summary_zh: 借鉴 RL 的 pass@k 分析，对比优化前后的 Harness，区分增益来自已有能力更可靠地发挥还是可解任务范围扩大。所测设置中，pass@1 优势可能在更大尝试预算下反转，属于 Harness 专项诊断评测。
backlog.title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization

backlog.summary_en: ChartEvo improves base MLLM accuracy on long-tail charts in ChartBench and ChartX via experience-driven harness-level self-improvement, jointly evolving reusable chart Skills and Tools and learning local tool-call chains.
backlog.summary_zh: ChartEvo 通过经验驱动的 harness 级自我改进，联合演化可复用的图表 Skills 与 Tools 并学习局部工具调用链，在 ChartBench 与 ChartX 长尾图表上提升了 base MLLM 的准确率。
backlog.title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning

backlog.summary_en: A linear readout, frozen after fitting, scores scaffold-code edits before execution, followed by candidate selection and retention using steering-split feedback. In the GPT-4o experiment, returned nodes score 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, versus 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation; these percentages are scores, not proportions of nodes returned.
backlog.summary_zh: 该方法用拟合后冻结的线性 readout 在执行前给脚手架代码修改打分，再依据 steering-split 反馈选择并保留候选。GPT-4o 实验返回节点在留出 HumanEval+ 上的得分为 87.0%，parent-rate 消融为 84.2%；这些百分比是得分，不是返回节点的比例。
backlog.title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run

backlog.summary_en: Phronix uses a predictor-validator-corrector loop to refine and retain MCP tools and associated skills from execution outcomes. Among tasks already solved during cold-start runs, warm-start runs inheriting the capability store achieve 93-95% first-attempt success; tasks not solved in cold-start runs are outside that denominator.
backlog.summary_zh: Phronix 通过 predictor-validator-corrector 循环，依据工具执行结果改进并保留 MCP 工具与关联技能。对冷启动已解决的任务，继承其能力库的热启动运行首次尝试成功率为 93-95%；该比例的分母不包括冷启动未解决的任务。
backlog.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents

backlog.summary_en: RSI-Opt uses historical run evidence to revise a reusable prompt, playbook, optimizer-code library, and decision cadence, archiving policies for later runs. Model training is the application task; the isolated benefit of recursive inheritance lacks a matched-budget control, and a held-out task description was accessed during development.
backlog.summary_zh: RSI-Opt 的 meta-agent 根据历史运行证据改写可复用的提示、playbook、优化器代码库和决策节奏，并归档策略供后续运行继承。模型训练是应用任务；递归继承的独立增益缺少匹配预算对照，且曾发生留出任务描述被读取的情况。
backlog.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training

backlog.summary_en: HarnessMM reuses resolved decisions to reduce later reasoning calls with fixed actor weights, while training feedback and validation selection iteratively refine companion harness configurations. The full DeepSeek Harness configuration reports higher success and lower Tokens/task; the entire gain cannot be attributed to RSI or callback substitution alone.
backlog.summary_zh: HarnessMM 在 actor 权重固定时复用已有决策，减少后续推理调用；另用训练反馈和验证选择迭代改进配套 Harness 配置。DeepSeek Harness 的完整配置报告成功率上升、Tokens/task 下降，不能把全部收益归因于单一 RSI 或替换组件。
backlog.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency

held_out.quote: episodes excluded from exploration and distillation

matched_budget.quote: online budget held fixed within each benchmark

backlog.summary_en: ReSight's Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, expanding embodied agents' memory access; OC-NaVQA average position error falls from 33.10 m to 24.72 m.
backlog.summary_zh: ReSight 用 Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) 把探索所得解转为可复用的记忆构建器、查询工具与技能，扩展具身智能体的记忆访问能力，使 OC-NaVQA 平均位置误差从 33.10 m 降至 24.72 m。
backlog.title: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents

backlog.short_title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
backlog.summary_en: The study uses retro to review Claude Code sessions on 30 SWE-bench Verified issues and propose harness changes. Researchers select 24 proposals for implementation and evaluate the resulting eligible changes alongside an author-written comparison on later tasks. Most evaluations encountering the target problem show no reduction in repeated work; selection involves humans.
backlog.summary_zh: 研究让 retro 回顾 Claude Code 在 30 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上的会话并提出 Harness 修改，研究者选择实施 24 个提案；其中可评估的变更与一个作者另写的对照一起用于后续任务评测。多数遇到目标问题的评估未减少重复工作；这是含人工选择的专项评测。
backlog.title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation

backlog.summary_en: VISTA retains harness versions and evidence in a graph while a meta-agent actively generates rollouts, probes failures, and revises instructions, executable skills, and coordination logic. Simulation experiments report higher success with fewer rollouts than static reflection; efficiency alone does not establish fully matched budgets.
backlog.summary_zh: VISTA 用 Harness graph 保留版本与证据，元代理主动生成 rollout、探测失败并修订指令、可执行技能及协调逻辑。仿真实验中相对静态反思报告更高成功率和更少 rollout；效率优势本身不能证明预算完全匹配。
backlog.title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents

backlog.summary_en: RSIV-Harness fixes model weights, revises the harness from failure traces, and uses anchor and memory checks for retention or rollback. Relative to the original-backbone static harness in the overall-results table, executability rises by +28.02 points and chart structure by +34.01. The ablation table reports an inconsistent baseline, and transfer does not improve every metric.
backlog.summary_zh: RSIV-Harness 固定模型权重，依据失败轨迹修改 Harness，以 anchor 和 memory 检查保留或回滚。相对总体结果表中原骨干的静态 Harness，可执行性提高 +28.02 点、图表结构提高 +34.01 点；消融表的基线数值与总体结果表不一致，跨骨干也并非全部指标提升。
backlog.title: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization

cross_model.quote: demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models

backlog.short_title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
backlog.summary_en: With the coding model frozen, HSE aggregates task, repository, and cross-repository evidence. Feedback evolves skills and also updates the external writer/evaluator rules and evidence weights, which are transferred to later rounds. Target-benchmark adaptation fixes those rules and updates only the skill library.
backlog.summary_zh: HSE 在冻结编码模型下，分层聚合任务、仓库与跨仓库证据；反馈既演化技能，也更新 writer/evaluator 的外部规则与证据权重，并传给后续轮次。目标基准适配阶段固定这些规则，只更新技能库。
backlog.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent

backlog.summary_en: Skill Dreaming extracts executable knowledge from PR streams, builds and continuously refines a repository-specific skill library to guide coding agents implementing features while synchronously maintaining tests, documentation, and repository conventions.
backlog.summary_zh: Skill Dreaming 从 PR 流中提取可执行知识，构建仓库专属技能库并持续精炼，用于指导编码代理实现功能，并同步维护测试、文档与仓库约定。
backlog.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams

backlog.summary_en: RuHarness co-evolves scoring criteria and harness: continuously discovering and re-evaluating behavioral criteria from trajectories, prioritizing most relevant unresolved weaknesses to guide harness updates, outperforming strong harness-evolution baselines on unseen tasks.
backlog.summary_zh: RuHarness 让评分准则与 harness 共同演化：从执行轨迹持续发现并重估行为准则，优先处理最相关的未解决弱点以指导 harness 更新，在未见任务上优于强 harness 演化基线。
backlog.title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement

backlog.summary_en: FilingLoop revises procedural Reviewer and Filer skills from requirement-level feedback on scored batches and applies them to later unattempted cases with fixed model weights. This is online adaptation from historical feedback, not an independent held-out evaluation.
backlog.summary_zh: FilingLoop 用已评分批次的要求级反馈改写 Reviewer 与 Filer 的程序性技能，供后续未尝试的案例使用，模型权重保持不变；这是在线历史反馈适应，不能视为独立留出集验证。
backlog.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision

backlog.summary_en: Masked Erosion studies how acceptance gates can erode redundant safeguards in a textual harness around a fixed model, with accepted edits becoming later parents. Most experiments deliberately impose deletion pressure to isolate gate behavior, rather than estimate general deployment failure rates.
backlog.summary_zh: Masked Erosion 研究固定模型外部的文本 Harness 在接受闸门下如何逐步丢失冗余安全约束：被接受的修改成为后续父代。主要实验人为施加删除压力，用于隔离闸门行为，不能概括为部署中的普遍失效率。
backlog.title: Masked Erosion: How Acceptance Gates Lose Redundant Safeguards in Self-Improving Agents

backlog.summary_en: This safety evaluation studies how user appreciation affects personal agents’ authorization judgments under indirect prompt injection. MetaClaw turns session feedback into reusable skills for later conversations; skill evolution and reinforcement-learning weight updates are separately tested branches, not joint co-evolution in one agent.
backlog.summary_zh: 该安全评测研究用户赞许如何影响个人代理面对间接提示注入时的授权判断。MetaClaw 把会话反馈写成可复用技能并用于后续会话；技能演化和强化学习权重更新是分别测试的分支，不能当成同一代理的协同演化。
backlog.title: Appreciation Teaches Unauthorized Execution: Self-Evolution Degrades the Robustness of Personal Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection

backlog.summary_en: The study diagnoses changes in skill utility after policy-weight updates and uses readouts and failed trajectories to guide skill edits. In closed-loop experiments, an editor revises the textual skill bank and paired validation decides retention for later windows; the separate diagnostic experiments keep the skill bank fixed.
backlog.summary_zh: 研究在策略权重更新后诊断技能效用变化，并用 readout 和失败轨迹指导技能编辑。在闭环实验中，编辑器修改文本技能库，配对验证决定是否保留到后续窗口；独立诊断实验则固定技能库。
backlog.title: Before the Next Rollout: Diagnosing Skill Utility Shifts from Policy Updates

backlog.summary_en: The method compiles uncertain skill operations into programs, repairs skills and code using execution errors and check discrepancies, and retains validated program assets for later skills. Development inspected held-out failures, so a frozen asset bank at test time does not establish fully independent held-out validation.
backlog.summary_zh: 该方法把技能执行中的不确定操作编译为程序，利用执行错误和检查差异修订技能与代码，并保存验证后的程序资产供后续技能复用。开发时曾查看留出失败案例，测试期冻结资产库并不意味着完全独立的留出验证。
backlog.title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation

backlog.short_title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight
backlog.summary_en: ViCoR implements visual reflexes as editable Python guide functions, adjusts triggers using visual feedback, and checkpoints the library when episode scores improve for reuse in later episodes. Reflexes wake a fast vision model rather than directly issuing actions.
backlog.summary_zh: ViCoR 将视觉条件反射实现为可修改的 Python 引导函数，用视觉反馈调整触发规则，并在回合分数改善时保存技能库供后续回合复用。反射负责唤醒快速视觉模型，动作仍由模型决策。
backlog.title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents

backlog.summary_en: RSI Tax evaluates Harness and related self-improvement methods by recording task outcomes before updating persistent state, separating task-execution tokens from improvement tokens. It tracks subsequent artifact use, which does not establish an accuracy benefit or an actual monetary bill.
backlog.summary_zh: RSI Tax 以先记录任务结果、再更新持久状态的协议评测 Harness 等自改方法，并区分任务执行与改进调用的 token 成本。它记录工件是否在后续使用；该标签不证明准确率收益，也不等于实际账单。
backlog.title: The RSI Tax: When Recursive Self-Improvement Is Not Worth the Cost

backlog.summary_en: MULTILOOP revises a multi-agent Harness using training-task scores and trajectories, retaining versions for rollback and selecting the best training performer. Observed changes mainly concern prompts, tool declarations, and a download tool; deeper orchestration problems and additional inference costs remain.
backlog.summary_zh: MULTILOOP 依据训练任务成绩和多代理轨迹修改 Harness，保存版本以便回滚并选择训练表现最佳者。实际改动主要集中于提示、工具声明和下载工具；深层编排问题与额外推理成本仍未消除。
backlog.title: MULTILOOP: Evolving Multi-Agent Harnesses for Complex Information-Seeking Tasks

backlog.short_title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
backlog.summary_en: SIM preserves problem hypotheses, code attempts, and feedback for executable Harness revisions, helping an inherited Harness continue adapting to a new model or dataset. The task Harness changes, while the optimizer’s planning and search procedures remain fixed.
backlog.summary_zh: SIM 为可执行 Harness 的修改保留问题、代码尝试与反馈历史，帮助继承的 Harness 在新模型或数据集上继续修订。被改写的是任务 Harness；改进器的规划和搜索程序保持固定。
backlog.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement

backlog.summary_en: RoboCoEvo rewrites failure detectors and shared recovery programs from the current robot policy’s failures, reuses programs after held-out recovery testing, and trains the policy on successful recoveries. Programs and policy then continue evolving together in simulation.
backlog.summary_zh: RoboCoEvo 根据当前机器人策略的失败改写检测器和共享恢复程序，经留出恢复测试后复用，并以成功恢复数据训练策略。程序与策略随后继续迭代，构成仿真中的权重和 Harness 共演化。
backlog.title: RoboCoEvo: Expanding Robot Capabilities through Agent-Policy Co-Evolution

backlog.summary_en: SAGE-VQA stores executable functions in procedural memory, revises them through trial execution or post-answer feedback, and reuses completed versions on later questions. The procedural-tool path is the relevant Harness component; evaluation includes post-answer memory updates rather than a fully frozen memory bank.
backlog.summary_zh: SAGE-VQA 的程序记忆保存可执行函数，试运行或答后反馈可触发修订，完成的版本供后续问题复用。此处纳入程序工具子链；其评测包含答后记忆更新，并非全程固定记忆库。
backlog.title: SAGE-VQA: A Training-Free, Self-Evolving Agentic Framework with Grounded Evidence for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

intro.en: This edition includes 32 reviewed and approved papers: Harness RSI: 27; Evaluation, benchmarks & attribution: 4; Theory & surveys: 1. Harness RSI has the most papers in this edition.
intro.zh: 本期完成审查并获批准 32 篇论文：Harness / 脚手架 RSI 27 篇、评测、基准与归因 4 篇、理论与综述 1 篇。本期论文最多的方向为 Harness / 脚手架 RSI。

items.short_title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
items.summary_en: ELITE integrates independently proposed code mechanisms into an executable agent and admits descendants through compilation and execution-protocol checks. The loop uses no downstream task scores, and accepted changes can still fluctuate in performance.
items.summary_zh: ELITE 将并行提出的代码机制整合进可执行代理，并以编译和执行协议检查决定下一代；环内不使用下游任务成绩，已接受修改也可能出现性能波动。
items.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents

items.summary_en: The procedural-skill branch of MIRIX AutoDream judges session outcomes from execution transcripts, then uses a curator to create, edit, or delete skill instructions for later agents. Skills acquired on training tasks are frozen and evaluated for reuse on new tasks. Inclusion rests on feedback-driven revision of procedural steps, separate from semantic-record consolidation and factual retrieval. The experiments evaluate the combined process, without isolating the benefit of every skill edit or individual component.
items.summary_zh: MIRIX 的 AutoDream 程序性技能分支根据会话轨迹判断成败，再由 curator 创建、编辑或删除供后续 Agent 使用的技能指令。训练任务形成的技能库冻结后，在新任务上评估复用。纳入依据是反馈驱动的程序性步骤修订，语义记录合并与事实检索不属于这条证据；实验评估的是整套流程，未单独证明每次技能修改或某个组件的收益。
items.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System

items.summary_en: RemeshingAgent revises executable pipeline templates and skill instructions from mesh-repair trajectories, replacing the incumbent only after held-out selection improves and testing separately. Its tool-expansion experiment produced no adopted new operator.
items.summary_zh: RemeshingAgent 从网格修复轨迹修改可执行流水线模板和技能指令，只有留出选择集改善才替换当前技能，并另作测试；工具算子扩展实验未产生被采用的新算子。
items.title: RemeshingAgent: An Iterative Agent for Repair-Based Decimation of Generated Building Meshes

items.summary_en: Synapse repairs natural-language skills using execution traces to locate faults and typed patches to rewrite skill source, with a separate validation suite selecting retained versions. Acceptance requires an improved overall pass rate, not preservation of every previously passing case.
items.summary_zh: Synapse 以程序修复方式修改自然语言技能：执行轨迹定位问题，类型化补丁写回技能，再由独立验证集选择保留。接受依据是整体通过率提升，并不保证每个旧样例都不退化。
items.title: Synapse: Optimizing Natural-Language Agent Skills through Program Repair

items.summary_en: MetaAct synthesizes executable action constraints from successful and failed trajectories, checks false blocks through log replay, and uses counterexamples for revision. Accepted constraints persist in deployment. Compilation and blocking mechanisms remain fixed, and the retirement monitor was inactive in the reported results.
items.summary_zh: MetaAct 从成功与失败轨迹合成可执行动作约束，利用日志回放检查误拦截并将反例用于修订；被接受的约束可持续部署。实验中的编译与拦截机制固定，退役监视器未实际触发。
items.title: MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents

items.summary_en: WeVisForensics updates both visual-inspector weights and reusable reporting rules. Rule revisions must improve judgments on held-out recent calls without losing previously correct judgments before publication to subsequent rounds. The visual OCR consistency inspector also trains, while audio tools and the PaddleOCR detector remain fixed.
items.summary_zh: WeVisForensics 同时更新视觉检查器权重和可复用的报告规则；规则修订须在近期留出调用上改善判断并保留既有正确判断，再发布到后续轮次。视觉 OCR 一致性检查器也参与训练；音频工具和 PaddleOCR 检测器保持固定。
items.title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection

items.summary_en: Continual-ARC evaluates persistent agent harnesses on a stream of recurring ARC tasks with fresh instances, using reset controls and frozen seen-task and held-out tests. The tested systems retain programs and skill files across sessions. Persistence alone generally gives limited memorization gains; explicit guidance to write, verify and reuse programs helps on returning tasks, while gains on unseen tasks remain small or absent. This is a harness-focused evaluation, not evidence that feedback-budget comparisons match training and teacher costs.
items.summary_zh: Continual-ARC 用反复出现且实例更新的 ARC 任务流，比较可保留程序和技能文件的 Agent Harness 与清空状态的对照；流结束后冻结系统，分别测试已见任务的新实例和未见任务。论文观察到，持久化本身的记忆收益有限，明确的程序编写、验证与复用指导能改善已见任务表现，而未见任务的泛化收益仍很小或没有。纳入为 Harness 专项评测；反馈预算可比不代表模型训练与教师成本完全匹配。
items.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime

items.summary_en: AHE-Beta turns execution evidence into general requirements and merges reusable harness updates after design and code review.
items.summary_zh: 把运行证据转成通用需求，通过设计和代码审查将可复用脚手架更新合入后续版本。
items.title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses

items.summary_en: Within each episode, navigation feedback revises policy code and improvement rules for later goals; independent episodes reset both.
items.summary_zh: 在单个episode内依据导航反馈修订策略代码与改进规则，供后续目标复用；独立episode重置。
items.title: Improve How You Improve: Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Navigation

items.short_title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
items.summary_en: Frozen models revise prompts and skill files using practice scores and transcripts, then evaluate the retained text on unseen games in fresh sessions.
items.summary_zh: 冻结模型根据练习得分与轨迹改写提示和技能文件，并在全新会话的未见游戏上评测保留文本。
items.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?

items.summary_en: Multi-objective evolutionary search tunes external action-gating policies for audio agents, selecting trade-offs between action risk and clarification cost.
items.summary_zh: 以多目标演化搜索调优语音代理的动作门控，在错误风险与澄清成本之间选择策略。
items.title: Great Listeners, Poor Decision-Makers: Rethinking Agentic Audio AI

items.summary_en: OpenKAGE revises executable skills from open-world experience and shares them through a registry for subsequent agent use.
items.summary_zh: 在开放世界中从执行经验修订可执行技能，并通过共享注册库供后续代理调用。
items.title: OpenKAGE: Open-Ended Lifelong Learning in the Open World via Knowledge-Sharing Agent-Group Evolution

items.summary_en: BaseRSI selects transferable prompt procedures and visual-processing entries from failures, then iteratively internalizes their verified gains into model weights.
items.summary_zh: 从失败中筛选可迁移的提示程序与视觉处理条目，再将验证后的增益逐轮内化到权重。
items.title: BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization

items.summary_en: SCAFFOLD proposes a theory and reporting protocol for evidence transport and readmission of versioned skills, without an implementation or empirical results.
items.summary_zh: 提出版本化技能证据迁移与重新准入的理论和报告协议；尚无实现或实证结果。
items.title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills

items.summary_en: The method evolves loadable prompt, tool-description and skill adapters from failed trajectories, retaining a Pareto archive over success, cost and latency.
items.summary_zh: 从失败轨迹演化提示、工具描述与技能适配器，以任务效果和成本筛选可复用版本。
items.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization

items.summary_en: Meta-RTL traces RTL-optimization failures to agent harness decisions, searches reusable code changes and evaluates a frozen selected harness.
items.summary_zh: 将硬件优化失败追溯到代理脚手架决策，搜索可复用代码改动并冻结评估。
items.title: Meta-RTL: Evolving Agent Harnesses for RTL Optimization

items.summary_en: SkillPlumber revises skills using execution coverage and verifier feedback, while a maintainer updates diagnostic and revision strategies for later tasks.
items.summary_zh: 结合执行覆盖与验证反馈修订技能，并把诊断和修改策略沉淀给后续任务的改进器。
items.title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills

items.summary_en: Sage-Evolve-Preview revises prompts, skills and observation-controller rules from recurring failures, committing updates after repair and regression checks.
items.summary_zh: 从反复失败中修订提示、技能与观察控制规则，经修复和回归检查后提交更新。
items.title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement

items.summary_en: JevRSI asynchronously revises procedural decision-support modules from execution feedback and publishes them for later reuse through utility-aware retrieval.
items.summary_zh: 从决策执行反馈异步修订程序性模块，发布到共享库并按历史效用供后续任务复用。
items.title: Think Once, Act Fast: Cost-Effective Recursive Self-Improvement for Decision Model Harness

items.summary_en: SceneAnything validates revisions to parameterized scene generators and stores accepted programs for retrieval and adaptation in subsequent scenes.
items.summary_zh: 根据重建检查修订参数化场景生成程序，将接受的程序存入库供后续场景检索适配。
items.title: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video

items.summary_en: Decision-model, state-prompt and behavior-tree updates are tested on new opponents; a fixed-weight controller effect is not isolated.
items.summary_zh: 联合修订决策模型、状态提示与行为树后测试新对手；未隔离固定权重下的控制器效果。
items.title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice

items.summary_en: MedicalRSI evolves executable tools and workflow skills from clinical task feedback alongside training of the solver and improver.
items.summary_zh: 从临床任务反馈修订可执行工具和工作流技能，并与求解器、改进器训练协同迭代。
items.title: MedicalRSI: Medical Recursive Self-Improving Agents via Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution

items.summary_en: A focused evaluation of prompt, skill, memory, and harness evolution analyzes how proposal quality, selection, and run-to-run variance affect the detectability of improvements.
items.summary_zh: 对提示、技能、记忆与脚手架演化做专项评测，分析提案、选择与运行方差如何影响可辨识收益。
items.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements

items.short_title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills
items.summary_en: This dedicated study measures repeated feedback-free skill rewriting, traces loss of expert knowledge and tests attention markers that preserve the original text.
items.summary_zh: 专项评测无反馈的反复技能改写，揭示专家知识流失，并测试保留原文的注意标记。
items.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study

items.summary_en: NavRSI iteratively rewrites navigation harness code from traces and diagnoses, then freezes the selected harness for transfer evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 利用导航轨迹和失败诊断迭代改写代码脚手架，冻结选定版本后评估迁移。
items.title: NavRSI: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Vision-and-Language Navigation

items.summary_en: RoHa-SGG uses failure-root-cause analysis to revise inference harness code and selects a retained version before test evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 根据场景图生成的失败根因改写推理脚手架，经独立选择后保留有效版本。
items.title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation

items.summary_en: In a simulated personal-assistant setting, failure traces guide instruction repairs for future tasks, with validation separated from adoption.
items.summary_zh: 在模拟个人助理环境中从失败轨迹修订指令，经验证与独立采纳决策后用于未来任务。
items.title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates

items.summary_en: Team agents repair the prompts, tools, and evaluation harness in response to operational faults. Human-approved fixes take effect at warm restarts while each task’s search archive is preserved.
items.summary_zh: 团队代理根据运行故障修复提示、工具与评测脚手架，经人工批准在热重启启用，保留各任务搜索档案。
items.title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First

items.summary_en: Pilot rollout traces and student evaluations guide repeated revisions of teacher skills, with experiment history retained across rounds. Each student is fine-tuned anew from the same initial weights.
items.summary_zh: 用试跑轨迹和学生评测反复修订教师技能，跨轮保留实验史；学生每轮均从同一初始权重微调。
items.title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher

items.summary_en: Embodied-Harness revises reusable operational guidance from robot execution evidence and applies the updated harness to subsequent attempts.
items.summary_zh: 从机器人执行证据提炼并修订操作指引，让更新后的脚手架指导后续尝试。
items.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation

items.summary_en: EvoTER proposes skill revisions from tool-use experience, retains accepted updates across rounds and freezes the skills for disjoint test tasks.
items.summary_zh: 从工具执行经验提出技能修订，经任务验收后跨轮保留，并冻结技能评估留出任务。
items.title: EvoTER: Evolving Embodied Agents via Tool-Use Experience and Reflection

items.summary_en: CoEvoBench evaluates joint model and harness improvement and tests the nominated frozen model–harness pair in an independent environment.
items.summary_zh: 评测代理能否联合改进模型与脚手架，并在冻结的独立测试中检验最终组合。
items.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
